senses.gloss:
ध्रु ध्रु, i. 1 and 6, Par.
 1. To stand firm.
 2. To go.
 3. To know.

† ध्रुव् ध्रुव्, i. 6, Par.
 1. To stand firm.
 2. To go.

ध्रुव ध्रुव (akin to धृ),
 I. adj., f. वा.
 I. Firm, stable, MBh. 1, 808; Rām. 1, 60, 17.
 2. Permanent, Nal. 6, 11.
 3. Fixed (as a day), MBh. 14, 1888.
 4. Certain, Man. 7, 169.
 II. m. The polar star, MBh. 8, 2105; personified as son of Uttānapāda and grandson of Manu, 13, 195.
 2. A name of Viṣṇu, 2, 1510.
 3. The name of a Vasu, 1, 2528, and others.
 III. n. Permanence, Hariv. 3959.
 IV. adv. ˚वम्, Certainly, Man. 12, 16.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. O.H.G. ga-triuwi; Goth. triggvs; A.S. treowe, for truwian; perhaps Lat. durus.
ध्रुवच्युत् ध्रुव-च्यु + त्, adj. Felling what in firm, Chr. 290, 11 = Rigv. i. 64, 11.
ध्रुव- + संधि ध्रुव- + संधि, m. a proper name, Rām. 1, 70, 26 Gorr.
